questions.question: List the multiples of 6 and of 8 below 50 and identify the common multiples.
questions.expected_answer: Multiples of 6: 6, 12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 42, 48. Multiples of 8: 8, 16, 24, 32, 40, 48. Common multiples: 24 and 48, and 24 is the lowest common multiple.

questions.question: List all the factors of 24 using factor pairs and explain how you know none is missing.
questions.expected_answer: Pairs: 1 times 24, 2 times 12, 3 times 8, 4 times 6. Trying 5 fails, and 6 pairs back with 4, which is already found, so the list is complete: 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24.

questions.question: Explain how 4 times 6 equals 24 can be described using the words multiple and factor, and find the highest common factor of 24 and 36.
questions.expected_answer: 24 is a multiple of 4 and a multiple of 6; 4 and 6 are factors of 24. Factors of 24 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 and factors of 36 are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 9, 12, 18, 36; the common factors are 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 12, so the highest common factor is 12.
